# Test fixtures

<!-- Generated by: phpscript test --matrix -o ../../docs/test-fixtures.md ./... -->

Every `.phpt` fixture in the suite, one table per folder. A fixture states a
behavior and records what PHP itself produces for the same source, so a table
below is a compatibility report rather than a record of what phpscript printed
last. See [testing.md](./testing.md) for the fixture format and how to add one.
